stdout:
Update a channel. Use this tool to update a channel.

Usage:
  yutu channel update [flags]

Examples:
# Update channel description
yutu channel update --id UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --description 'New description'
# Update channel title and country
yutu channel update --id UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --title 'New Title' --country US
# Update channel default language
yutu channel update --id UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --defaultLanguage en

Flags:
  -c, --country string           Country of the channel
  -u, --customUrl string         Custom URL of the channel
  -l, --defaultLanguage string   The language of the channel's default title and description
  -d, --description string       Description of the channel
  -h, --help                     help for update
  -i, --id strings               ID of the channel to update
  -o, --output string            json|yaml|silent
  -t, --title string             Title of the channel
      --yes                      Confirm the operation
